name: claude-md-link-check
tagline_zh: 项目里 CLAUDE.md 的 @路径和链接悄悄失效？只读扫描每个文件，报出 file:line 精确断点。
tagline_en: Find every broken @path and markdown link in all CLAUDE.md files. Read-only, reports exact file:line refs. Never.
desc_en: Verify every @path chain import and every markdown link inside every CLAUDE.md in this project resolves to an existing file. Read-only — returns broken links with file:line refs, never edits.
why_zh: 同类工具只查单文件，它递归扫全项目，且只读不写，给出行列号，修不修你说了算。
why_en: Unlike single-file checkers, it scans the whole project recursively, read-only, and pinpoints exact line numbers—no edits, just.
